meta.name: slideshow
meta.description: Author a HyperFrames slideshow — a presentation, pitch deck, or interactive deck with discrete slides, fragment reveals, branching, hotspot navigation, and built-in presenter mode with speaker notes; also converts an existing page into a deck. Output is a navigable deck, not a rendered MP4. If the user didn't explicitly ask for a slideshow, confirm before authoring. Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把内容编排成可翻页的演示文稿
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要把想法整理成演示文稿
copy.tagline_en: Create a navigable slideshow from your content
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you regularly need to turn ideas into a slide deck

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把内容编排成可翻页的 HyperFrames 幻灯片演示:支持逐条显现、分支跳转、热点导航和带演讲备注的演示模式;也能把已有网页改造成幻灯片。产出是可交互的演示文稿,不是视频文件。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求做幻灯片、slide show 或 HyperFrames slideshow 时直接执行;当提到“演示文稿”“pitch deck”“把此页转成幻灯片”等近似请求时,会先确认是否做成 HyperFrames 幻灯片再动手;意图不清时转 /hyperframes。

howto.what_en: After install, Claude turns content into a navigable HyperFrames deck: discrete slides, fragment reveals, hotspot branching, presenter mode with notes. It can also convert an existing page into a deck. Output is a deck, not an MP4.
howto.when_en: Triggers on explicit slideshow or HyperFrames slideshow requests. For adjacent terms like 'presentation', 'pitch deck', or 'convert this page', it confirms first. Unclear intent routes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn this outline into a slideshow, one point per slide.
Convert this webpage into a deck, keeping its style and motion.
say_en.note: Confirms first, then ports the page as slides.

say_en.text: Add a button that jumps to the detailed-data branch.
say_en.note: Adds a hotspot that navigates to a branch slide.
